title: Lesson 75: Incident Response for Agents: Hallucinations, Data Leaks, Rollback, and Postmortems
description: The responder arc for an agent that acted while nobody watched: freeze the trace before rollback, roll back by action class and compensate where reversal is impossible, and run a blameless postmortem that ships a fix.

questions.question: Before rolling back or restarting an agent after confirming an incident, what must happen first?
options: Delete the affected session logs so that the bad behavior is not preserved in long-term storage
Revert to the last known-good prompt so the agent stops taking harmful actions
Export or snapshot the incident window's trace to storage independent of production
Restart the agent to clear its in-memory state before the investigation begins
questions.explanation: Recovery destroys evidence: a rollback swaps the running version and a restart clears in-memory state. The trace must be frozen to independent storage before any recovery action, or the record of what happened is lost.

questions.question: A sent customer message later turns out to be wrong. How does rollback by action class treat this case?
options: It cannot be unsent, so the response is a corrective follow-up plus an impacted-customer list
It is idempotent like a database write, so it can be reversed with a standard transactional rollback
It can be recalled because the agent still holds read access to the customer inbox
It can be ignored once the agent is restarted and the message becomes untraceable
questions.explanation: Some actions cannot be reversed, only compensated. A message already sent cannot be unsent, so the substitute is a follow-up correction and the list of customers affected, not a revert.

questions.question: In a detection chain from harmful action to human acknowledgement, what does a delay between the signal firing and the tripwire tripping point to?
options: Missing instrumentation on the path where the agent took its action
A tripwire that never fired and therefore needs to be built or repaired
Poor alerting hygiene, because the page never actually reached a human on call
A slow human response after the page was received and acknowledged
questions.explanation: Each gap in the detection chain has its own root cause. A delay between signal and trigger means a tripwire that should have fired did not, so the fix is the missing or broken tripwire.
